corners.note: Turn count as given by Wikipedia for this layout. The FIA map numbering is the reference for turn labels.
corners.named_note: No corner names verified for this circuit.

direction.basis: OSM loop oriented to match the TUMFTM file order (stored in driving direction)
direction.note: Computed from the orientation of the race-direction centreline.

lap_record.note: Fastest lap set during a race (Wikipedia convention: race laps only). 2026-season records are only listed if Wikipedia already shows them.

centreline.s0: Point beside the middle of the OSM pit lane. Approximate start/finish line only.

tumftm.not_used_reason: TUMFTM length 5547 m is +266 m off the FIA length (older layout), while the OSM loop is +16 m off, so the OSM loop is used.

centreline.tumftm_missing_alternative: OpenStreetMap circuit ways (used here, no widths). Better: trace both track edges from aerial imagery or the FIA circuit drawing to get widths.

elevation.note: Computed from a terrain model sampled along the centreline and smoothed over about 30 m. SRTM includes buildings and trees, so on a street circuit the figure is rough. No official elevation figure was verified.

track_width.note: Not verified. No TUMFTM file and no OSM width tags. Measure from aerial imagery or the FIA circuit drawing. The older-layout TUMFTM file gives 10.0 to 15.5 m (median 12.8 m), which is a fair guide for the unchanged parts of the track.

kerbs.note: Kerb types and positions are not published as data. Lines quoted from the FIA Race Director notes ("Changes to the Circuit") where they mention kerbs. The current build derives kerbs from curvature.

osm_hints.note: Only what OSM contributors have mapped near the track; incomplete at most circuits.

run_off.note: Run-off surfaces per corner are not verified. FIA lines quoted where they describe gravel, asphalt, grass, walls or barriers.

track_limits:
18.1 In accordance with the provisions of Article 33.3 of the Sporting Regulations, the white lines
define the track edges. During Qualifying Session and the Race, each time a driver fails to
negotiate the lap within the track limits, this will result in that lap time being invalidated by the
Stewards.
18.2 Additionally, each time a driver fails to respect track limits at the entry or exit Turn 16, will
result in that lap time and the immediately following lap time being invalidated by the
Stewards.

pit_lane.speed_limit_source: FIA 2026 F1 Sporting Regulations B1.6.3a default (80 km/h); the Race Director notes do not amend it (2025 notes; 2026 notes not issued yet)
pit_lane.side_basis: OSM pit lane position relative to the race-direction centreline
pit_lane.length_note: Length of the OSM pit lane way (usually includes the entry and exit roads). Not an official figure.
pit_lane.fia_entry_exit_rules:
14.1 In accordance with Chapter 4, Articles 4 and 6 of Appendix L to the ISC drivers must
follow the procedures at pit entry and pit exit.
14.2 For safety reasons, drivers must keep to the right of the solid white line at the pit entry when
entering the pits.
14.3 Pertaining to Chapter 4, Article 4 of Appendix L to the ISC any driver crossing the safety
car line 1 to the right hand side of the orange bollard at pit entry will be considered as entering
the pit lane.
14.4 Overtaking is prohibited in the pit exit road unless a car slows with an obvious problem.
14.5 During the reconnaissance laps prior to the Race drivers are allowed to cross the white line
separating the pit exit road from the circuit.

garages.note: Not verified. The FIA pit lane drawing (fia_map source) shows the garage layout per team.

sectors.note: The 2025 map gives intermediate points but not sector lengths.

drs.note: DRS points as printed on the FIA map. Detection and activation lists are not always one to one (several activation points can share one detection point).

overtaking.note: The 2026 event has not taken place, so the 2026 straight mode zones are not published. The 2025 DRS points are the best available guide; 2026 zones will likely sit on the same straights but this is not confirmed. Replace when the 2026 FIA circuit map is issued.

landmarks.note: Grandstands, bridges, tunnels and buildings come from OSM within a few hundred metres of the track (s_m = distance along the pack centreline, side = left/right in race direction). "named" are notable features mentioned in the Wikipedia article, without positions.

sources.what: English Wikipedia article "Yas Marina Circuit" (infobox, layout "Grand Prix Circuit (2021–present")
FIA 2025 circuit map, pit lane drawing and emergency exits (Race Director document)
OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): circuit ways, pit lane, landmarks, run-off hints

gaps: TUMFTM file is an older layout; OSM centreline used, no current-layout track widths.
Kerb types and positions not verified as data (only FIA change notes).
Run-off surface per corner not verified (only FIA change notes and OSM hints).
2026 FIA circuit map not issued yet; sectors and overtaking use 2025 DRS data.
